title: NBlockMoney
body:
💰 NBlockMoney
NBlockMoney is a lightweight plugin for Minecraft servers (Folia/Paper) that rewards players with money for mining blocks. It’s perfect for survival, skyblock, or mining servers where you want to motivate players to explore and dig.

✨ Features
Block rewards — each block configured in config.yml grants the player a specific amount of currency upon breaking
Reward multiplier — each player has an individual multiplier (boost) that scales the amount received
Dynamic boost update — the player’s multiplier refreshes automatically every 100 blocks mined, ensuring rank/level progression works without relogging
Integration with PlaceholderAPI — the multiplier value is retrieved from any placeholder (e.g., rank, level, points), ensuring full compatibility with other plugins
Integration with Vault — payouts are handled by Vault, ensuring compatibility with any economy system on the server
Action bar — the player can see in real-time how much they’ve earned for each ore/block mined
Support for Folia — the plugin is fully compatible with the multi-threaded Folia
